items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Well Sidney Bashier, Sidney Bashier, he's still playing that piano... I always just like his playing.

ctx.x: I think he's waking tomorrow night at the time. I like to hear him come back on Suprano. He played that one day. Who was that, Clarence? Clarence. There's not many Suprano players left.
Well Sidney Bashier, Sidney Bashier, he's still playing that piano.
I play that Suprano. He left before you left. Oh yeah, he left before what?
